title: [markedjs/marked] Fix issue #4052: escape ampersands in link hrefs
description:
Fix GitHub issue #4052 in markedjs/marked:
https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4052

Repo:
https://github.com/markedjs/marked

Target:
Fix the CommonMark link/autolink href escaping bug where an ampersand such as < is emitted raw and changes the browser's link target. Account for the repository's existing inline-link behavior so the fix does not double-escape already-decoded destinations, and add focused regression coverage for autolinks and inline links.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change upstream against markedjs/marked.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #4052.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Clearly reference https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4052.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit code plus the upstream PR.
